game: AWAY@HOME / kickoff not in pack / HOME +3.5 (AWAY -3.5) / total 49 / weather not saved

script.base: Market has AWAY leading but not pulling away: HOME +3.5 in a 49 total implies about 26-23. Competitive into the second half, both teams throwing. AWAY leans on PLY12 (42 carries, 179 rush yards L3) and primary target PLY11 (43 targets, 343 rec yards, 380 air yards). HOME's run game has been poor (PLY09 35 carries, 107 yards, 3.06 YPC; X10 another 19 carries), so HOME keeps throwing to PLY17/PLY08/PLY05 to stay in range rather than grinding.
script.flip1: AWAY jumps ahead early, feeds PLY12, and drains the clock. AWAY pass volume stalls, so PLY11's 84.5 rec-yard line is the one that dies; HOME then abandons the run and PLY09 rush stays dead.
script.flip2: Shootout or HOME grabs a lead: HOME never establishes PLY09 (rush under holds) and both WR1s stay live. A weather or defensive-slog flip cannot be tested — forecast is not in the pack.

injury_fallout: No injury report, practice trend, questionable tags, or inactive list in the as-of pack, and no beat-writer notes. No offensive or defensive absence can be assigned, so no next-man-up target/carry share and no backup coverage matchup. Final-report and 90-minute inactive checkpoints are not available here; any late scratch would force a re-run.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. Location YPA is the proxy. HOME: left 7.58 (78 att), middle 8.56 (34 att), right 7.89 (81 att) — middle is the soft spot, and every zone is leaky. AWAY: left 5.68 (72 att), middle 7.18 (38 att), right 5.08 (71 att) — perimeter is tight, middle is the only soft zone.
matchup.pressure: HOME blitz rate 27%. AWAY QB EPA/dropback is -0.08 vs blitz (n=80) vs +0.15 with no blitz, so pressure that gets home kills PLY11 deep shots (380 air yards L3) and boosts checkdowns to PLY12 (27 targets, 50 air) and PLY16 (8 targets, 9 air). AWAY blitz rate 31%. HOME QB stays positive vs blitz (+0.09, n=68) and better clean (+0.20), so AWAY pressure does not break HOME's pass game.
matchup.bleeds: HOME run defense allows 5.18 YPC and 23 runs of 10+ in 6 games, plus 19 passes of 20+ on 209 att (9.1%). AWAY run defense allows 4.35 YPC and 19 runs of 10+, but only 11 passes of 20+ on 192 att (5.7%). AWAY bleeds the middle and holds the edges; HOME bleeds the run and every pass location.
matchup.overlap: Bet overlap is PLY11, AWAY's primary target (43 targets, 380 air yards), into a HOME pass defense allowing 7.58-8.56 YPA and a 9.1% explosive-pass rate. PLY12's 42 of 66 listed L3 carries into HOME's 5.18 YPC defense is the cleaner rush overlap, but 67.5 sits above his 59.7 L3 rush mean, so it is not a leg. PLY17 (332 air yards on 30 targets) does not attack AWAY's weak middle; he runs into a defense that has allowed only 11 explosives. PLY05 (95 air on 20 targets) does fit that middle, but a 30.5 line versus a 59.7 L3 mean is an unexplained market gap with no role note in the pack.

form: L3 aggregates only; no game splits, so a single long play inside these totals cannot be ruled out. PLY11 14.3 tgt/g and 114.3 rec yds versus a 84.5 line. PLY12 14.0 car/g, 59.7 rush yds, 4.26 YPC, plus 9.0 tgt and 37 rec yds. PLY04 57.3 rec yds on only 5.3 tgt — efficient and thin. PLY09 11.7 car/g, 35.7 rush yds at 3.06 YPC, with 6.7 tgt and 51.3 rec yds, so he is a pass-game back and 52.5 rush is 17 yards above the rush mean. PLY17 88.7 rec / 110.7 air; PLY08 60.7 rec / 97.3 air; PLY05 59.7 rec / 31.7 air. No OC, QB, or teammate change is recorded.

edge_players.edge_sentence: PLY11 is AWAY's primary target (43 targets, 380 air yards, 343 rec yards over L3) against a HOME pass defense allowing 7.58/8.56/7.89 YPA and 19 gains of 20+, and 84.5 is well under that role in a game AWAY is favored by only 3.5.
edge_players.must_be_true: Full route share, about 10+ targets, and a competitive score so AWAY does not spend the second half clock-killing with PLY12. HOME's blitz stays near 27%, not the dominant look, because AWAY QB EPA drops to -0.08 when blitzed.
edge_players.kills_it: AWAY leads by multiple scores early and the pass game stalls, or HOME blitzes more than 27% and the 380 air yards never convert. An unsplit L3 spike inside the 343 yards would also mean 84.5 is not a discount.

edge_players.edge_sentence: PLY09 has averaged 35.7 rush yards on 3.06 YPC, HOME is a 3.5-point dog in a 49 total, and AWAY's run defense (4.35 YPC) is not a bleed that forces a grind, so 52.5 needs a carry script this side is not set up to play.
edge_players.must_be_true: HOME does not control the clock. PLY09 stays near 11.7 carries or fewer (X10 already had 19 L3 carries), and he does not break a long run. Efficiency does not jump to 5+ YPC on a full workload.
edge_players.kills_it: HOME leads or the game becomes a short-field grind and he gets 14+ carries. At 4.0 YPC, 14 carries is 56 and the under loses. One 15-20 yard run on a low-volume day also kills it.

data_check.notes: No projection, sim median, or Pinnacle no-vig in the pack, so this check is L3 role versus the listed line only. PLY11 L3 114.3 rec yds versus 84.5 over: agrees, with the unsplit 343-yard sample as a caveat, not a cut. PLY09 L3 35.7 rush yds versus 52.5 under: agrees. PLY12 rush over 67.5 is the textbook carry-share plus weak run defense (HOME 5.18 YPC, 23 runs of 10+) in a favorite script, but L3 mean 59.7 is under 67.5; treated as a lean, so dropped rather than flagged. No model probability to treat as a suspect 70%+ number.

market_rung_price: PLY11 recyds over 84.5 at -114.5, main line only; no alt rung in the pack. PLY09 rushyds under 52.5 is listed with price nan, so the rung cannot be priced from the pack. No short-priced alts. One market per player. Receptions and TDs are out of scope.
pre_mortem: Monday both lost. PLY11: the 343 L3 yards were one spike plus two quiet games, AWAY led big at half, PLY12 ran the clock, and HOME's 27% blitz showed up early so he finished well under 84.5. PLY09: the game stayed close, HOME protected the ball, he got 16 carries, and one chunk run against a 4.35 YPC defense pushed him past 52.5. That counter-case is real because game splits and weather are missing, but it is not stronger than the read, so both stay leans rather than drops.
slip_story: One story: competitive game under a 49 total, AWAY only -3.5, both teams throwing, HOME not grinding. PLY11 recyds over is the AWAY pass-volume leg into a leaky pass defense; PLY09 rushyds under is the HOME abandon-the-run leg. They lose together only if HOME controls and runs while AWAY's pass game also dies, which is not the base script. Do not add PLY17 or PLY08 overs (deep shots into a defense that has allowed 11 explosives on 192 att) or a total under. No TD legs.
